facts.fact: CIVIX, the national exchange point created in July 2013, has 14 connected operators and providers, per ARTCI at its first peering forum in Abidjan.
Traffic: 20 Gbps (average, per day) at CIVIX on 2025-08-05, as stated by ARTCI at the first Ivorian peering forum.

ARTCI announced recently the official launch of a third point of presence for CIVIX with Raxio in the neutral data centre at Grand-Bassam, a city other than Abidjan; the article gives no launch date and no members there, so the forum date is used.

note: Netflix, Google, Meta named as state partnerships in general, not as members or caches at CIVIX, so no content fact.
